integration_overview.role: Chip-to-chip interconnect between packet processors, traffic managers, framers, and switch fabrics
integration_overview.topology: Point-to-point over N bonded SerDes lanes per direction; words striped across lanes
integration_overview.channels: Up to 65536 logical channels multiplexed over the link
integration_overview.init_sequence: Receiver word-locks each lane on the Synchronization Word, synchronizes descramblers via Scrambler State Words, deskews on metaframe boundaries (clock-compensating with Skip Words), then de-stripes; link up when Diagnostic Words report all lanes operational.
